reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, nice catch! The stream converter already merges a usage-only chunk into the held `message_delta`, so asking for it was the missing piece.

We checked it against OpenRouter: it accepts `stream_options` without complaint (it also sends usage without being asked, so the bug never showed there). We couldn't test a backend that needs the flag, such as DashScope, but the change follows the Chat Completions spec.

We pushed a small commit on top: merged `main`, removed the added comment (we keep new code comment-free), and added a CHANGELOG entry. Approving and merging. Thanks again!
